summary: OpenAI announces a partnership with the American Psychological Association to develop resources, convenings and safeguards for youth mental health and AI use.

practices.reason: Describes a lab-internal safety process (expert consultation, age-prediction model, under-18 Model Spec principles) that is disclosed but not a transferable measurement method for an engineering team.
practices.quote: We work with more than 260 mental health experts to help ChatGPT better recognize signs of distress, respond with care, and guide people toward real-world support.
